title: VCMI script format
description: Format used to define scripts of any kind in VCMI

implements.description: Which part of the game this script implements. 'spellEffect' is an effect of a spell, 'combatEvent' reacts to events that happen to a unit in combat

compatibilityIdentifiers.description: Additional identifiers that may refer to this object, to provide compatibility after object has been renamed

script.description: path to the script that represents this object

items.description: list of patches that modify this script

schema.description: Json schema for validating the parameters that every user of this script passes to it

stringRegistrations.description: Parameters of this script that hold text shown to the player, and are to be registered for translation

description.description: description of the ability shown to the player, may refer to script parameters as ${parameterName}

priority.description: order in which scripts reacting to the same combat event run, from lowest to highest. Defaults to 0
